request: There's a bug: `paginate()` drops the last item on every page. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: The bug is in `paginate()` in src/pager.py: the slice ends at `end - 1`, so the last item of each page is cut off. I'll change the slice to end at `end`.
summary: I've fixed the slice in `paginate()` so each page now keeps its last item.

request: Hi! `parse_date()` crashes on timestamps with a trailing Z, like '2024-03-05T10:00:00Z'. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `parse_date()` in app/utils/dates.py passes the string straight to `datetime.fromisoformat`, which rejects the trailing 'Z' on our Python version. I'll replace the 'Z' with '+00:00' before parsing.
summary: I've updated `parse_date()` to convert a trailing 'Z' to '+00:00' before parsing.

request: Hi! The cart total ignores quantities: two of the same item only count once. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: In `cartTotal()` in src/cart/totals.js the reducer adds `item.price` without multiplying by `item.qty`. I'll multiply each price by its quantity.
summary: I've changed `cartTotal()` to multiply each item's price by its quantity.

request: A 15% discount code only takes 0.15% off the invoice. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `apply_discount()` in billing/invoice.py divides the percentage by 10000 instead of 100, so a 15% code takes off 0.15%. I'll fix the divisor.
summary: I've fixed the divisor in `apply_discount()` so percentage codes take off the right amount.

request: Hi! `slugify()` leaves uppercase letters in the slug: 'Hello World' becomes 'Hello-World'. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `slugify()` in lib/slugify.py replaces spaces with hyphens but never lowercases the text. I'll add a `.lower()` call before the replacement.
summary: I've added lowercasing to `slugify()`, so 'Hello World' now becomes 'hello-world'.

request: Hi! `isExpired()` returns false for sessions that expired yesterday. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: In src/auth/session.ts, `isExpired()` checks `expiresAt > now` instead of `expiresAt < now`, so the result is inverted. I'll flip the comparison.
summary: I've flipped the comparison in `isExpired()`, so past expiry times now count as expired.

request: Hi! The CSV loader skips the first data row of every file. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `read_rows()` in etl/load.py calls `next(reader)` twice, so it skips the header and then the first data row as well. I'll remove the second call.
summary: I've removed the extra `next(reader)` in `read_rows()`, so the first data row is no longer skipped.

request: Hi! Search can't find words that are followed by punctuation, like 'hello,'. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `tokenize()` in src/search/index.py splits on whitespace only, so punctuation stays attached to the words. I'll split on runs of non-word characters instead.
new: return [t for t in re.split(r"\W+", text.lower()) if t]
summary: I've changed `tokenize()` to split on non-word characters, so trailing punctuation no longer blocks matches.

request: The /users endpoint returns a 500 error when the limit parameter is missing. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `ListUsers` in api/handlers/users.go parses the `limit` query parameter with no default, so an empty value fails to parse. I'll fall back to 50 when it is empty.
summary: I've made `ListUsers` default `limit` to 50 when the parameter is missing.

request: Prices show one decimal place, e.g. '$4.5' instead of '$4.50'. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `format_price()` in src/utils/money.py formats the value with one decimal place. I'll switch the format to two decimal places.
summary: I've changed `format_price()` to always show two decimal places.

request: Hi! Weekly jobs run one day after their scheduled day. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: In scheduler/cron.py, `next_run()` adds `days_ahead + 1` days to the base date, so every job lands one day late. I'll remove the extra day.
summary: I've removed the extra day in `next_run()`, so jobs land on their scheduled day.

request: There's a bug: Clicking the + button several times quickly only raises the counter by one. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: `increment` in src/components/Counter.jsx calls `setCount(count + 1)` with a stale `count` from the closure. I'll use the functional form of `setCount`.
summary: I've switched `increment` to the functional `setCount` update, so rapid clicks all count.

request: There's a bug: Reserving stock lets the available quantity go negative. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: `reserve()` in inventory/stock.py raises only `if available > qty`, which is the wrong way round. I'll raise when the requested quantity exceeds what is available.
summary: I've corrected the check in `reserve()`, so it now refuses requests larger than the available stock.

request: Hi! The retry delay never grows: it waits one second before every attempt. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `backoff()` in utils/retry.py returns `base * 2 ** 0` instead of using the attempt number. I'll use `2 ** attempt` so the delay doubles.
summary: I've made `backoff()` use the attempt number, so the delay now doubles on each retry.

request: Environment variables don't override the values in config.yaml. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `load_config()` in src/config/loader.py merges the environment values first and the file values second, so the file wins. I'll swap the merge order.
summary: I've swapped the merge order in `load_config()`, so environment variables now take precedence.

request: The weekly report crashes with ZeroDivisionError for weeks with no data. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `mean()` in reports/stats.py divides by `len(values)` without checking for an empty list. I'll return 0.0 when the list is empty.
new: return sum(values) / len(values) if values else 0.0
summary: I've made `mean()` return 0.0 for an empty list instead of raising.

request: There's a bug: Emails with a plus sign, like 'ann+news@example.com', are rejected at signup. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: The regex in `isValidEmail()` in src/validators/email.js doesn't allow '+' in the part before the @. I'll add it to the character class.
summary: I've added '+' to the allowed characters in `isValidEmail()`.

request: Passing -vv only sets the verbosity to 1. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `build_parser()` in cli/args.py registers `-v` with `store_true`, so repeated flags don't add up. I'll switch it to a counting flag.
summary: I've switched `-v` to a counting flag, so -vv now sets the verbosity to 2.

request: There's a bug: Orders of exactly $50 are charged shipping, but free shipping should start at $50. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: `shipping_cost()` in orders/shipping.py grants free shipping only when `total > 50`. I'll change it to `>=` so $50 orders qualify.
summary: I've changed the threshold check in `shipping_cost()` to `>=`, so $50 orders ship free.

request: There's a bug: The LRU cache evicts entries that were just read. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: `get()` in src/cache/lru.py returns the value without moving the key to the end, so recently read entries still look old. I'll call `move_to_end` on a hit.
summary: I've made `get()` mark the key as recently used, so reads no longer get evicted first.

request: Truncated titles come out one character longer than the limit. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `truncate()` in src/text/truncate.ts keeps `max` characters and then appends the ellipsis. I'll keep `max - 1` characters so the total fits.
summary: I've adjusted `truncate()` so the result, including the ellipsis, fits the limit.

request: There's a bug: Every step in the funnel report shows a conversion rate of 0. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: `conversion_rate()` in analytics/funnel.py uses integer division, which rounds every rate below 1 down to 0. I'll use true division.
summary: I've switched `conversion_rate()` to true division, so rates are no longer rounded down to 0.

request: URLs with a trailing slash, like /users/, return 404. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `match_route()` in src/router.py compares the raw path, so '/users/' doesn't match the '/users' route. I'll strip a trailing slash before matching.
summary: I've made `match_route()` strip a trailing slash, so '/users/' now matches '/users'.

request: There's a bug: Migrations are applied in the wrong order: migration 10 runs before migration 2. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: `pending()` in db/migrations/runner.py sorts the migration names as strings, so '10_...' comes before '2_...'. I'll sort by the numeric prefix.
summary: I've made `pending()` sort migrations by their numeric prefix.

request: Hi! Distances between cities are wildly wrong: London to Paris shows over 5,000 km. Can you fix it and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `haversine()` in src/geo/distance.py passes the coordinates in degrees straight into `sin` and `cos`. I'll convert them to radians first.
new: lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(math.radians, coords)
summary: I've added the degree-to-radian conversion in `haversine()`.

request: Users who unsubscribed still receive the weekly digest email. Could you fix this and make sure the tests pass?
diag: `send_digest()` in notifications/email.py filters on `user.subscribed is not None`, which is also true for users who unsubscribed. I'll filter on `user.subscribed` being true.
summary: I've fixed the filter in `send_digest()`, so unsubscribed users are skipped.

request: There's a bug: The search box sends a request on every keystroke even though it is debounced. Please fix it and make sure the tests pass.
diag: `useDebounce` in src/hooks/useDebounce.js never clears the previous timer when the value changes. I'll return a cleanup function that clears it.
